closed.shape_source: the blink was observed; its lid shape is the open eye flattened to 12 % (estimated shape)

confidence.note: confidence = visible area / the part's own full area; angles below 0.5 are interpolated and listed per frame in pose_track[].interpolated

synthesized.note: nothing in this file is invented. Poses and expressions that the renderer makes up at animation time (sit, laugh, look, …) are reported by `animate` as synthesized.
